## What you did

- Prepared the prod PG17 cutover in Terraform with RDS blue/green, with the read replica following the deployment instead of being replaced; the plan shows 2 changes and 0 destroys. [1]
- Ran the full cutover on a snapshot clone: 74 s of write unavailability, API pods reconnected via pgbouncer without restarts, and no row-count mismatch on the 20 largest tables. PR #321 was opened with Maya as reviewer. [1][3]

## What changed

- The window moved to **Sunday 22/11, 02:00–04:00 UTC**: Fernhill's month-end batch runs Saturday night until ~06:00 UTC. Maya has informed the CSMs and authorized merging #321. [8]
- Maya's approval of #321 was conditional on the window being confirmed — that condition is now met. [3][8]
- Renovate's PR #320 bumps the AWS provider from 5.80 to 5.82 with automerge disabled. [4]

## What is still open

- Update `runbooks/pg17-cutover.md` and the Notion page (still showing Saturday 21/11), then merge #321. [8][10]
- Rehearse rollback on a fresh clone on Thursday 19/11: measure its duration and data loss — rollback is not a switch-back, since blue diverges immediately after switchover. [1]
- Give Lior Ben-David 30 minutes' notice before the switchover so the ingest consumers can be paused cleanly; no worker changes are needed on his side. [9]
- Daniel Levi is on call for the API side on Sunday: ping him when you start the switchover. [7]
